bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to commerce; appropriating money for membership in the National Council of Insurance Legislators.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS.

$20,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $20,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of commerce to pay membership dues for Minnesota to the National Council of Insurance Legislators. The appropriations in this section are onetime.
